name: Poisoned Lock (Lionlodge)
disable: DC 23 Thievery check (expert) on the spring mechanism.

items.name: Spring
items.text:
Trigger A creature tries to unlock or Pick the Lock

---

Effect The needle extends to attack the triggering creature.

items.name: Enhanced Hunting Spider Venom
items.text:
Saving Throw DC 23 basic Fortitude save

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

---

Stage 1 1d10 poison damage and Off-Guard (1 round)

Stage 2 1d12 poison damage, Clumsy 1, and off-guard (1 round)

Stage 3 2d6 poison damage, Clumsy 2, and off-guard (1 round).

---

Note The clumsy condition caused by this venom persists for 24 hours before fading.

text: A spring-loaded, poisoned needle is hidden near the drawer's keyhole. Disabling or breaking the trap does not disable or break the lock.
